transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi, Doc. Well, I'm here because of my eating. What really brings me in is that... after I do it, I just sit there looking at all the empty containers, and I feel completely disgusted with myself. I've always tried to be a steady, in-control kind of man, and... well, doing this makes me feel like I'm not that guy at all. I just need to figure out how to get a handle on it.
After these episodes happen, do you do anything to try to get rid of the food or prevent weight gain?

No, I don't. I don't do anything to get rid of it. I know some folks might make themselves sick or take something, but... no, I don't do that. I just sit there feeling awful about what I just did, and I guess I just let it stay with me.
About how often are you having these eating episodes?

Well, since I've been stuck at home with this back injury... it's been happening a lot. I'd say several nights most weeks. Honestly, looking back over the last three months, I can't think of a single week where I didn't do it at least once.
